primary_leap_existence_rule.source_scope: 《大明大統曆法》步氣朔卷第一
primary_leap_existence_rule.normalized_rule: Compute 閏餘 from the source year accumulation and 閏應 under 朔策; compare the remainder with 閏限. A remainder at or above 閏限 marks a leap year.
primary_leap_existence_rule.note: This rule decides whether the year has an intercalary month; by itself it does not name that month.

leap_position_rule.received_statement_scope: Late-Ming reform report preserved in the Qing-compiled Ming history.
leap_position_rule.normalized_old_datong_rule: 大統置閏，但論月無中氣: old Datong placement is determined by whether the civil lunar month contains a Zhongqi, without the new-law exact conjunction-order refinement.
leap_position_rule.exact_time_contrast: The same report says the new method additionally considers whether Zhongqi occurs before or after the next conjunction on the same civil day.

computational_bridge.month_membership_rule: Assign Zhongqi by source civil-day labels: new-moon start day <= Zhongqi day < next new-moon start day. A lunar month with no such Zhongqi repeats the preceding month number and is intercalary.
computational_bridge.month_number_anchor: The interval containing winter-solstice Zhongqi is month 11; subsequent regular Zhongqi map 12,1,2,... in order.
computational_bridge.precision_profiles: Reuse the four 12OX profiles only as sensitivity controls; no profile is promoted to historical authority.

1596_same_day_diagnostic.mechanism: The relevant Zhongqi and the next conjunction occupy the same source civil day; Zhongqi occurs earlier in exact time. Old day-level attribution puts that Zhongqi on the next month-start day, leaving the preceding month without a Zhongqi. An exact-order comparator would retain the earlier Zhongqi in the preceding month.
1596_same_day_diagnostic.historical_use: This is a computational illustration of the Ming-history old/new semantic contrast, not a claim that the later Western-method calendar was run for 1596.

adjudication.reason_g09_stays_open: The sampled controls establish the algorithmic family and several ordinary/intercalary years, but arbitrary-year certification still requires a Ming-era boundary census to find years where a true conjunction or Pingqi Zhongqi lies close enough to a source-day boundary that unresolved precision/source-coordinate issues could alter the month identity.

next_research_priority.focus: Run a full Ming-era 1368-1644 boundary census under all four research precision profiles. Identify any year whose leap placement or month identity changes by profile, and rank source-day-boundary critical cases for direct almanac/reign-record validation before considering G09 closure.
